description: Astronomi alanına ilgi duyarım uzay hakkında yeni bilgiler öğrenmeyi severim.B1-B2 seviyeleri arasında İngilizcem var.Voleybol oynamayı severim.Ben yaratıcı fikirler üreten,başarılı ve hırslı bir katılımcıyım benimle birlikte çalışan katılımcılara da aynı ruhu aşılamaya özen gösteririm. Takım arkadaşlarımda aradığım özellikler hırslı olmaları,ekip ruhu ve konu hakkındaki yeteneklerinin hepsini kullanabilmeleri.
summary:
Our project, Traces Left Behind in the Stars, explores the spacecraft and equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space after NASA missions.

We developed a presentation about space missions, including the Ranger, Surveyor, Apollo, Viking, Voyager, and other spacecraft. We explained their missions and what happened to them.

Our project shows what happens to spacecraft after their missions end and explains how they contributed to space exploration through photographs, scientific research, and discoveries.

It is important because it helps us understand the history of space exploration, appreciate scientific achievements, and learn how these missions helped us discover more about the universe.
details: Our project, "Traces Left Behind in the Stars", is an informative presentation about spacecraft left on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. It explains their missions, discoveries, and what happened to them after their missions ended. The project helps people understand the history of space exploration and the importance of NASA's missions. It provides information about spacecraft such as Ranger, Apollo, Voyager, and Perseverance. We used research, written information, pictures, and presentation design tools to develop our project. We did not use any coding languages or special hardware because our project is a presentation. Our project is creative because it combines scientific information with space-themed visuals. We considered accuracy, readability, interesting facts, and visual design to make it educational and enjoyable.
